name: fabric-connection-inventory
description: Read-only tenant connection and ownership inventory for Microsoft Fabric.

scripts.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
scripts.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
scripts.test: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && node --test packages/shared/test/fabric-api.test.mjs && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend test
